# Userscripts

Small, focused userscripts by [Nolly](https://github.com/thenolle). Each lives in its own folder with its own source, guides, changelog and version.

**[Read the documentation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/)**

## Scripts

| Script | Version | What it does | Links |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Better Perplexity** | 1.0.1 | A modular userscript that adds the missing parts of the Perplexity web app: reliable usage tracking, better code blocks, long-message handling, a prompt library, batch runs and real exports. | [Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenolle/userscripts/dist/better-perplexity/better-perplexity.user.js) · [Docs](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/) |
| **Userscript Core** | 0.1.1 | Shared runtime, utilities and build tooling for every userscript in this repository. Write features, not plumbing. | [Install]() · [Docs](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/) |

## Installing

1. Install a userscript manager such as [Violentmonkey](https://violentmonkey.github.io/) or [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/).
2. Open a script's **Install** link and confirm.
3. Updates arrive automatically from this repository.

## What is inside

### Better Perplexity

A modular userscript that adds the missing parts of the Perplexity web app: reliable usage tracking, better code blocks, long-message handling, a prompt library, batch runs and real exports.

[Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenolle/userscripts/dist/better-perplexity/better-perplexity.user.js) · [Documentation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/) · [Changelog](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/changelog/) · [Source](https://github.com/thenolle/userscripts/tree/master/better-perplexity)

Guides:

- [Getting started](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/getting-started/): Install Better Perplexity, take the built-in tour and learn where everything lives.
- [Usage tracking](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/usage-tracking/): How remaining queries, totals and refill estimates are calculated, and what to do when they look wrong.
- [Long messages](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/long-messages/): Paste any amount of text, see the size as you type, and split or attach it only when it is too big.
- [Prompts and batches](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/prompts-and-batches/): Reusable prompts with placeholders, community prompts from GitHub, and running one message over a whole list.
- [Code blocks and export](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/code-and-export/): Better code blocks with language badges, and exporting threads as Markdown, Word, PDF or plain text.
- [Shortcuts and settings](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/shortcuts/): Every keyboard shortcut, how Enter works, the command palette and the selection toolbar.
- [Architecture](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/architecture/): How Better Perplexity is built on the shared @nolly/core package.
- [Troubleshooting](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/better-perplexity/troubleshooting/): Fixes for missing buttons, wrong usage numbers, failed exports and update problems.

### Userscript Core

Shared runtime, utilities and build tooling for every userscript in this repository. Write features, not plumbing.

[Install]() · [Documentation](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/) · [Changelog](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/changelog/) · [Source](https://github.com/thenolle/userscripts/tree/master/core)

Guides:

- [Getting started](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/getting-started/): Create a userscript on top of the core in a few minutes.
- [API reference](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/api/): Every export of the core package.
- [Build and release](https://thenolle.github.io/userscripts/core/build/): How headers, bundling and dist output work.

## How this repository works

- One folder per userscript, each a TypeScript project built with [Bun](https://bun.sh).
- A version bump on `master` publishes a release, a minified build and an update feed on the `dist` branch.
- The documentation site lives on the `website` branch and rebuilds from these folders on every change. It is built with [Gambrel](https://github.com/thenolle/gambrel).
